fact: The World Bank's implementation report, with results dated 28 November 2023, states that GOSE, an EMIS developed by MENFOP and being rolled out in phases, gives each pupil a unique identifier from pre-school to senior school, that the school principal registers and transfers pupils in the application, that pupil and teacher absenteeism are transmitted to central management through it, and that all public schools transmit their data via GOSE, with extension to refugee and private schools and the addition of student grades still planned.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Expanding Opportunities for Learning (P166059), Seq No: 9
